preconditions.description: The number of shamans N must be between 2 and 100,000.
The maximum number of trusted friends D must be between 1 and 500.
The number of days U must be between 0 and 200,000.
The number of questions Q must be between 1 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each altitude H_i must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] < N and 0 <= B[i] < N and A[i] != B[i] for i in range(U))
preconditions.description: Each pair of trusted friends A_i and B_i must be valid indices and distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and x != y and 0 <= v <= U for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid indices for x and y, and a valid day v.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min(abs(H[x_prime] - H[y_prime]) for x_prime in trusted_friends[x] for y_prime in trusted_friends[y]))
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum distance between trusted friends of x and y on day v.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if any(x_prime == y_prime for x_prime in trusted_friends[x] for y_prime in trusted_friends[y]) else stdout
postconditions.description: If x and y share a trusted friend, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1000000000' if not trusted_friends[x] or not trusted_friends[y] else stdout
postconditions.description: If x or y has no trusted friends, the output must be 1,000,000,000.
